name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_reaches_deep
summary: Induction on I by its largest n: each step (a, n) is the operator B = p^{cost} + Σ_l coordRetract(υ zτ⁻¹(t_l − 1)) of exists_reaches_depth_succ, which costs cost(a, n) and raises the depth at (a, u) from n to n + 1; compose.

steps.claim: Induction on I (Finset.induction_on_max_value for the second coordinate n): each step adds an element whose n is at least that of every element already present (ties at other first coordinates allowed):
steps.lean:
I.induction_on_max_value (·.2) ⟨.id _, by simp [Reaches], fun _ _ _ m _ J ↦
  m.imp_right fun m g ↦ mem_withExponents_of_le (m g) (by simp_all)⟩ fun ⟨a, n⟩ I q N ⟨A, R, Y⟩ ↦ by
  obtain ⟨_, t, υ, Z⟩ := S.extLattice.exists_reaches_depth_succ a n
  let B := p ^ cost a n • .id _ + ∑ l, AddMonoidHom.mk' (S.extLattice.coordRetract <|
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) ·.2⟩) (by simp [← map_add, add_sub_add_comm])
  have T : S.Reaches (cost a n) B := fun i c x ⟨⟨_, f⟩, m⟩ ↦ by
    simp [B] at f ⊢
    exact sum_mem fun l _ ↦ ⟨coordRetract_mem_withExponents _ (smul_mem _ υ
      (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep x.2 (m _))), by simp [S.projTriv.map_coordRetract _ 0,
      ← f, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj, k.galMonoid.smul_def]⟩
  refine ⟨B.comp A, fun i c x m ↦
    (sub_mem_iff_left _ (T (R.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements m m))).1 (by
    simp [← smul_sub, R m, q, pow_add, mul_smul, nsmul_mem]), fun i c x m d J ↦ ?_⟩
  have Y := Y m (fun b u ↦ ite (b = a ∧ d b u = n + 1) n (d b u))
    (have := (J · · · (n + 1)); by clear * - this J N q; grind)
  refine (T.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements Y Y).imp_right fun H g ↦
    mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil (H g) fun b u v l μ m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨y : (A x).1 ∈ invariantsMod _, rfl, e⟩ := Y.2, (ite_ne_right_iff.1 l.ne).1
  obtain ⟨c, f⟩ := Z _ (A x).2 μ m.1 (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem _ _ (by
    simpa [e, ↓valueAt_smul_sub (A x).2.1 m.1] using! y ⟨_, ·, rfl⟩ |>.2 _ u v μ m))
  have F := valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil m.1 (p ^ _ • ⟨_, (A x).2.1⟩ + ∑ l,
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) (A x).2⟩) ((valueField _).1.2 c) (by simpa using f)
  erw [e, valueAt_smul_sub (B _).2.1 m.1]
  simpa [B, coordRetract_of_mem_kisinLoc, nsmul_mem, smul_sub, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf] using
    sub_mem (galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil g F) F

steps.claim: I = ∅: the identity has cost 0 and raises c₀ to c₁ when no step is needed, i.e. c₁ ≤ c₀ (mem_withExponents_of_le).
steps.lean:
⟨.id _, by simp [Reaches], fun _ _ _ m _ J ↦
  m.imp_right fun m g ↦ mem_withExponents_of_le (m g) (by simp_all)⟩

steps.claim: Adding (a, n) ∉ I with n ≥ every second coordinate of I (q; elements (a', n) of I with the same n are allowed), to I with operator A (cost R, raising Y):
steps.lean:
fun ⟨a, n⟩ I q N ⟨A, R, Y⟩ ↦ by
  obtain ⟨_, t, υ, Z⟩ := S.extLattice.exists_reaches_depth_succ a n
  let B := p ^ cost a n • .id _ + ∑ l, AddMonoidHom.mk' (S.extLattice.coordRetract <|
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) ·.2⟩) (by simp [← map_add, add_sub_add_comm])
  have T : S.Reaches (cost a n) B := fun i c x ⟨⟨_, f⟩, m⟩ ↦ by
    simp [B] at f ⊢
    exact sum_mem fun l _ ↦ ⟨coordRetract_mem_withExponents _ (smul_mem _ υ
      (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep x.2 (m _))), by simp [S.projTriv.map_coordRetract _ 0,
      ← f, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj, k.galMonoid.smul_def]⟩
  refine ⟨B.comp A, fun i c x m ↦
    (sub_mem_iff_left _ (T (R.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements m m))).1 (by
    simp [← smul_sub, R m, q, pow_add, mul_smul, nsmul_mem]), fun i c x m d J ↦ ?_⟩
  have Y := Y m (fun b u ↦ ite (b = a ∧ d b u = n + 1) n (d b u))
    (have := (J · · · (n + 1)); by clear * - this J N q; grind)
  refine (T.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements Y Y).imp_right fun H g ↦
    mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil (H g) fun b u v l μ m ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨y : (A x).1 ∈ invariantsMod _, rfl, e⟩ := Y.2, (ite_ne_right_iff.1 l.ne).1
  obtain ⟨c, f⟩ := Z _ (A x).2 μ m.1 (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem _ _ (by
    simpa [e, ↓valueAt_smul_sub (A x).2.1 m.1] using! y ⟨_, ·, rfl⟩ |>.2 _ u v μ m))
  have F := valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil m.1 (p ^ _ • ⟨_, (A x).2.1⟩ + ∑ l,
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) (A x).2⟩) ((valueField _).1.2 c) (by simpa using f)
  erw [e, valueAt_smul_sub (B _).2.1 m.1]
  simpa [B, coordRetract_of_mem_kisinLoc, nsmul_mem, smul_sub, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf] using

steps.claim: exists_reaches_depth_succ for extLattice(S) at a, n: elements t_l and υ with the depth gain Z.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨_, t, υ, Z⟩ := S.extLattice.exists_reaches_depth_succ a n

steps.claim: Let B(x) = p^{cost(a,n)}·x + Σ_l coordRetract(υ·zτ⁻¹(t_l·x − x)), additive on kisinLoc(Ỹ).
steps.lean:
let B := p ^ cost a n • .id _ + ∑ l, AddMonoidHom.mk' (S.extLattice.coordRetract <|
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) ·.2⟩) (by simp [← map_add, add_sub_add_comm])

steps.claim: Reaches(S, cost(a, n), B): for x ∈ deepElements(S, i, c₀), B(x) − p^{cost}x = Σ_l coordRetract(υzτ⁻¹(t_l x − x)) has exponents c₀ (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep, coordRetract_mem_withExponents) and maps to 0 (t_l fixes constantAt; map_coordRetract).
steps.lean:
have T : S.Reaches (cost a n) B := fun i c x ⟨⟨_, f⟩, m⟩ ↦ by
    simp [B] at f ⊢
    exact sum_mem fun l _ ↦ ⟨coordRetract_mem_withExponents _ (smul_mem _ υ
      (smul_sub_mem_zTauUnit_smul_of_deep x.2 (m _))), by simp [S.projTriv.map_coordRetract _ 0,
      ← f, constantAt, gal_smul_letterProj, k.galMonoid.smul_def]⟩

steps.claim: Take B ∘ A: its cost is cost(a, n) + Σ_I cost (B(Ax) − p^{…}x splits into two kernel parts, by 1.2.3, R and Reaches.mem_of_stable); it remains, for x ∈ deepElements(S, i, c₀) and c₁ covered by I ∪ {(a, n)} (J), that B(A(x)) ∈ deepElements(S, i, c₁):
steps.lean:
refine ⟨B.comp A, fun i c x m ↦
    (sub_mem_iff_left _ (T (R.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements m m))).1 (by
    simp [← smul_sub, R m, q, pow_add, mul_smul, nsmul_mem]), fun i c x m d J ↦ ?_⟩

steps.claim: A raises c₀ to c₂, equal to c₁ except that the value n + 1 at a is replaced by n (the steps below c₂ lie in I, by J and the maximality q).
steps.lean:
have Y := Y m (fun b u ↦ ite (b = a ∧ d b u = n + 1) n (d b u))
    (have := (J · · · (n + 1)); by clear * - this J N q; grind)

steps.claim: B keeps deepElements(i, c₂) (1.2.3, Reaches.mem_of_stable); to reach c₁, raise the exponent of each Galois difference at the places where c₂ < c₁ (mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil):
steps.lean:
refine (T.mem_of_stable kerWithExponents_le_deepElements Y Y).imp_right fun H g ↦
    mem_withExponents_of_mem_hodgeFil (H g) fun b u v l μ m ↦ ?_

steps.claim: there b = a, c₁(a, u) = n + 1 and c₂(a, u) = n (e), and A(x) is invariant modulo withExponents(i, c₂) (y).
steps.lean: obtain ⟨y : (A x).1 ∈ invariantsMod _, rfl, e⟩ := Y.2, (ite_ne_right_iff.1 l.ne).1

steps.claim: The value V of A(x) at (a, μ) has Galois differences in hodgeFil(n), so V is congruent modulo hodgeFil(n) to some c ∈ K' (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem); by Z the value of p^{cost}A(x) + Σ υzτ⁻¹(t_l A(x) − A(x)) is within hodgeFil(n + 1) of some c' ∈ K' (f).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨c, f⟩ := Z _ (A x).2 μ m.1 (BdR.exists_sub_mem_of_smul_sub_mem _ _ (by
    simpa [e, ↓valueAt_smul_sub (A x).2.1 m.1] using! y ⟨_, ·, rfl⟩ |>.2 _ u v μ m))

steps.claim: The same holds after coordRetract: valueAt(B(A(x))) − c' ∈ hodgeFil(n + 1) (valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil).
steps.lean:
have F := valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil m.1 (p ^ _ • ⟨_, (A x).2.1⟩ + ∑ l,
    υ • ⟨_, smul_sub_mem_zTau_kisinLocAinf (t l) (A x).2⟩) ((valueField _).1.2 c) (by simpa using f)

steps.claim: The value of g·B(Ax) − B(Ax) is g·valueAt(B(Ax)) − valueAt(B(Ax)) (valueAt_smul_sub).
It equals g(V' − c') − (V' − c') (c' ∈ K' is fixed, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf), which lies in hodgeFil(n + 1).
steps.lean:
simpa [B, coordRetract_of_mem_kisinLoc, nsmul_mem, smul_sub, galMonoid_smul_localFieldOf] using
    sub_mem (galMonoid_smul_mem_hodgeFil g F) F
